author: xMasterSlayer
body:
I know this is a new team and most of you will not even consider joining but think about this, "Every Team must start somewhere" even great teams like Berzerk, Apollo and Fortissimus (And others!) had to start with one member. However, I believe that if we can get enough members, I believe we could become one of the strongest and best pvp teams! I wish for this to one day be a tourney team! Plz fill in an application and help this team grow! We will scrim regularly even if we only acquire a few members. I have sent invites to numerous people and hope they will respond.
